verdicts.quote: Promotion is automatic. … automatic booking, not an "offer with a claim window"
first-come-first-served by the System's own record of when the join was accepted … ordered by a stable System-assigned tiebreak … There is no priority, no paid priority, no reordering by staff
A member is promoted into a class that overlaps another booking: … governed solely by the existing direct-booking rule (G-3)
verdicts.missing: Whether booking the first class removes the member from the overlapping waitlist or leaves that entry active for a later eligibility check.

verdicts.quote: it creates a booking for that member in the same operation that freed the seat … a member cancels a booking … a waiting member ends up booked without having to be watching.

they were promoted and are now booked, naming class and start time … Delivery failure is recorded (R-12) and retried within the notification channel's own rules. … reuse whatever the app uses for booking confirmations today
two seats freed at the same time promote the first two heads, each once … no run shows a confirmed count above capacity or a double promotion.
while the queue is non-empty a freed seat can be claimed only through promotion … it creates a booking for that member in the same operation that freed the seat, removes the entry
at promotion time the head member must pass whatever check a direct booking would pass today … including payment or credits … if the head fails the check, that entry is removed with a recorded reason
verdicts.missing: When payment is actually collected and whether a failed charge follows the same skip-and-notify rule as a failed eligibility check.

verdicts.quote: until decided the spec does not forbid a plan from enforcing a documented cap, but the acceptance below applies to the uncapped case.
verdicts.missing: Whether to impose a cap, its size, and what the next member sees when the queue reaches it.

verdicts.quote: Whether to stop promoting some minutes *before* start is not in the request (G-7, open); default A-5: promote until the start instant.
verdicts.missing: Whether to adopt an earlier cut-off and, if so, how far before the start promotions stop.

verdicts.quote: capacity is raised (frees *k* = new − old seats; promotes up to *k* heads in order) … no booking is removed by the waitlist and no promotion occurs until confirmed < capacity.
**Class cancelled** (by staff): all entries end with reason "class cancelled"; each member notified (R-7).
Waitlist entry (class, member, accepted-at, tiebreak, status, end reason) … The member's position is 1 + the number of active entries ahead of theirs for that class.
remaining active entries end with reason "class started" … ended entries and audit retention period: **unresolved**
verdicts.missing: How long an ended entry is retained after class start.

verdicts.quote: it shows only the member's own position, never the queue length or other people

roster showing the ordered queue (member name, join time, position), the count, and a Remove action … recorded with timestamp, class id, member id … event (join, leave, promote … Staff/Operators can retrieve them for a class.
verdicts.missing: Whether staff can manually trigger a promotion and, if so, which entry they can promote.

verdicts.quote: A **global** waitlist switch and a **per-class** override (on/off/inherit) exist.
it creates a booking for that member in the same operation that freed the seat … after a freeing operation returns success, a subsequent read by the promoted member shows the booking

everything the app does today for classes with open seats, for bookings and for cancellations behaves as before … book a seat in a class with space … existing classes, bookings and members need no migration of their own
after release no waitlist entries exist, and existing full classes show the empty-queue state. … global off, Fay sees no waitlist control on a full class; Operator switches on → control appears
